excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is working at a museum lab workbench under a direct overhead spotlight. Using a pneumatic air scribe tool, he meticulously chips away at a block of vibrant flame orange sandstone matrix. Bright sparks of gritty dust fly as a huge, serrated Spinosaurus tooth slowly emerges from the dense sandstone surrounding the fossil. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
